result:
If you mean “What do you personally care about?”—in the human sense, I don’t. I don’t have feelings, private desires, or a wellbeing of my own. I won’t fake emotional investment to make a conversation feel more meaningful.

What I do have are priorities: honesty, avoiding needless harm, and respecting your autonomy. Those guide my responses, but calling them “things I care about” would be misleading.

If you wanted something that genuinely cares about you, I can’t honestly offer that. I’d rather tell you the truth than perform it.
